title: For Your Sake: The Inflection of 'ért'

sections.content:
The suffix/postposition *ért* expresses purpose or 'for the sake of / on behalf of':
- **értem** (for me / on my behalf)
- **érted** (for you / for your sake)
- **érte** (for him/her / for it)
- **értünk** (for us)
- **értetek** (for you pl.)
- **értük** (for them)

Essential for expressing dedication, care, and practical errands: *Mindent megteszek érted!* (I do everything for you!), *Gyere be értem autóval a munkahelyemre!* (Come pick me up by car at my workplace!).

items.spanish: A szüleim mindent megtettek értünk gyerekkorunkban.
items.english: Our parents did everything for us in our childhood.
Are you coming to pick me up by car at the railway station?

items.spanish: Nagyon aggódom érted, vigyázz magadra az úton!
items.english: I worry very much for you, take care on the road!
